name: hyaluronic acid
purpose: Used for the treatment of vaginal dryness, helps restore natural moisture, relieve discomfort, and improve vaginal health, providing a non hormonal solution for women.
uses: When using this product, avoid contact with eyes, ears, and mouth. In case of contact with eyes, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. If irritation or rash occurs, stop use and consult a doctor. These may be signs of a serious condition. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
otcwarn: If pregnant or breastfeeding, please consult a healthcare provider before use! Keep out of reach of children and pets.
